_about: Object types an operation can act on. Assigned per (paper, op) by semantic_type.py from the stored section text, never by a static op->type map: the same verb acts on different objects in different papers (H1 ablation, 2026-08-24). Additive: add types and groups, don't rename.

object_types.state: estimate of a dynamical system's hidden state (x_t, belief, track)
object_types.error: prediction error or residual (target minus prediction)
object_types.gradient: gradient of an objective w.r.t. parameters
object_types.noise: noise variable or noise level (diffusion, SDE)
object_types.input: raw observation: pixels, tokens, audio, measurement
object_types.distribution: probability distribution, density, score function, posterior
object_types.sample: a drawn sample or particle set
object_types.other: none of the above — leave raw, do not force

compatibility_groups._about: Used by compare.py --semantic --relaxed. Types in one group count as a match. --strict requires identical types.
compatibility_groups._v2_note: value joins learning_signal: advantage/return is the RL analogue of a prediction error
compatibility_groups._trajectory_note: trajectory joins represented_state: a plan is a state sequence; relaxed treats predict@trajectory ~ predict@state/latent

object_types_v2._about: Phase 18 additions for RL and meta-learning. Used by semantic_type.py --v2. v1 types unchanged. Final test 2026-08-25: trajectory added for planning / sequence-generation papers (Diffuser).
object_types_v2.policy: a policy / behaviour function or its parameters (pi, actor)
object_types_v2.value: a value function, Q-function, advantage, or expected return
object_types_v2.task: a task, environment instance, or episode drawn for (meta-)learning
object_types_v2.trajectory: a sequence of states and/or actions over time (a plan, rollout, path tau = s0 a0 s1 a1 ...); the whole sequence is the object, not one state
